svg.title: Full system connection chain from mains through power conversion, the CM5 core, USB hubs, radios, and grounding
svg.desc: End-to-end diagram of the OmniComm hub: mains earth and power entering, the 12V power chain with UPS and battery, the CM5 carrier feeding two USB hubs and radios, and the chassis grounding scheme tying all three EMI compartments to protective earth.
svg.text: Red = power · Blue = USB data · Teal = RF (antenna) · Green = protective earth / ground bond

g.text: Protective earth (PE) — single star ground point
